These conditions introduce key uncertainty, as variable convective timing and cloud cover can suppress peak solar heating through shading and evaporative cooling, while any localized clearing could allow an extra degree of warming before official station resolution. May’s transitional monsoon pattern typically supports highs in this range, exceeding the climatological average of 33–34°C during clearer spells, with the closely matched market-implied odds reflecting trader assessment of these atmospheric variables ahead of the next model update.
